name: Eremophila-1(10),7(11)-diene
evidence: Measured in 5 of 6 MONDAYS hemp SKUs at 0.07–1.17% of total volatiles (0.014–0.23mg per chew).

consumer_summary.what_it_is: Eremophila-1(10),7(11)-diene is a naturally occurring sesquiterpene, a family of aromatic molecules that give many plants their signature scents. While its specific aroma is not widely documented, compounds of this type typically add earthy or woody notes to their environment.
consumer_summary.found_in: It has been identified in Othonna coronopifolia, a flowering shrub in the daisy family.
consumer_summary.why_researchers_care: This molecule is currently a blank slate in natural-product chemistry, with no published pharmacological studies to date. Researchers are often drawn to rare sesquiterpenes to understand how plants defend themselves, and discovering whether this compound has any biological activity remains an open, exciting frontier.
consumer_summary.evidence_at_a_glance: There is currently no published evidence evaluating the biological or health effects of this compound (Oxford level 5, none found).
